config ZMS
	bool "Zephyr Memory Storage (ZMS)"
	depends on FLASH
	select FLASH_MAP
	select CRC
	help
	  Enable support of Zephyr Memory Storage.

if ZMS

config ZMS_LOOKUP_CACHE
	bool "Zephyr Memory Storage lookup cache"
	help
	  Enable ZMS lookup cache, used to reduce the flash access
	  when searching for a ZMS entry.
	  Recommended when using ZMS with Settings.

config ZMS_LOOKUP_CACHE_SIZE
	int "Zephyr Memory Storage lookup cache size"
	default 64
	range 1 65536
	depends on ZMS_LOOKUP_CACHE
	help
	  Number of entries in ZMS lookup cache.
	  It is recommended that this be a power of 2.

config ZMS_DATA_CRC
	bool "Data CRC check in ZMS"
	help
	  Check the 32-bit data CRC each time a ZMS entry is read.
	  Notice that enabling this feature will increase the size of
	  the data section by 4 bytes for each stored non-small data entry.

config ZMS_NO_DOUBLE_WRITE
	bool "Do not write already existing data with the same ID"
	help
	  Before writing data to flash, read the previous value with the same ID
	  and skip the write if the data is identical.

module = ZMS
module-str = zms
source "subsys/logging/Kconfig.template.log_config"

endif # ZMS
